data_table.name: Data table
data_table.description: Shows the rows of a SQL query, a search or static data, with sorting, search, filters and an action per row.

chart.name: Chart
chart.description: Plots a query: one column for the X axis and one or more numeric series.

kpi.name: KPI
kpi.description: A key figure (with an optional change) from the first row of a query.

form.name: Form
form.short: Sends data to a workflow or agent
form.description: Validated fields that run a workflow (with an input mapping) or message an agent when submitted.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Streaming chat with an agent, with per-user memory and a notice when an answer waits for approval.

record_list.name: Record list
record_list.short: Items with a title and details
record_list.description: Compact list of records with a title, subtitle, fields and a badge.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Month or agenda view from a date column.

file_upload.name: File upload
file_upload.description: Files are indexed in a knowledge base and can start a workflow.

action_button.name: Action button
action_button.short: Runs a workflow or an agent
action_button.description: A button (with optional confirmation) that runs a workflow or asks an agent for something.

approvals_inbox.name: Approvals inbox
approvals_inbox.description: The project's pending approvals, with approve and deny according to the role.

list.title: Interfaces
list.description: Dashboards, apps and public chats connected to your agents, workflows and knowledge. They are published with the project.
list.emptyDescription: Build a dashboard over a knowledge table or publish a chat with your agent.
list.components: {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} · {screens, plural, one {# screen} other {# screens}}
list.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be removed from the project's code (it stays in the version history).
list.deletePublished: “{name}” is published: it stops being available at its public URL as soon as you delete it.

create.title: New interface
create.description: Start from a template. You can then edit every component, its data and the layout.
create.name: Name
create.noKb: Create a knowledge base with a table (for example by uploading a CSV) to connect the dashboard.
create.invoicesHint: Defaults to “facturas”. Expected columns: numero, cliente, importe, estado, fecha_emision, fecha_vencimiento.
create.noAgent: Create an agent in the Agents tab to publish its chat.

editor.saveInvalid: Not saved: {count, plural, one {there is # error} other {there are # errors}}
editor.canvasLabel: 12-column canvas. Drag to move and the corner to resize; with the keyboard, arrows move and Shift + arrows resize.
editor.chatOnly: A chat interface has a single component: configure it in the properties panel.
editor.emptyCanvas: Add components from the palette (click or drag) and connect them to your data.
editor.previewHint: Real data from the development environment (latest code). Unsaved changes are previewed too.
editor.codeObject: The interface must be a JSON object
editor.deleteComponentDescription: “{id}” will be removed from the interface. You can undo it by discarding the unsaved changes.
editor.leaveDescription: You will lose the changes you have not saved.
editor.idInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _ (start with a letter)
editor.idTaken: Another component already uses this id
editor.componentIdHint: Unique in the interface; it appears in the data routes.
editor.title: Title
editor.layoutHint: 12-column grid. Overlapping components are pushed down.

settings.name: Name
settings.slugHint: Folder name in interfaces/ and part of the public URL.
settings.loginRequiredHint: Only members of the organization with a Messer session.
settings.loginRequiredChatHint: Without login, each anonymous visitor has their own conversation.
settings.rolesHint: With none selected, any member can enter.
settings.deleteScreenDescription: The screen and all its components will be removed.

binding.noKnowledgeBases: There are no knowledge bases available to this project.
binding.generateHint: Write a query with every column of the table
binding.sqlHint: Read-only. Variable values go as $1, $2… in “Parameters”: they are never inserted into the SQL.
binding.paramsHint: No parameters. Add one for every $n of the query.
binding.queryInputHint: Name of the search box that replaces the default search (empty = no box).
binding.noAgents: This project has no agents yet.
binding.promptHint: Optional template: '{{form.field}}', '{{row.column}}', '{{file.filename}}', '{{user.email}}'. Empty = a summary of the fields.
binding.noWorkflows: This project has no workflows yet.
binding.staticHint: A list of objects (rows) or a single object.

props.emptyText: Text when there is no data
props.xAxisHint: Category or date column (defaults to the first one).
props.seriesHint: Comma-separated numeric columns (defaults to every numeric column).
props.valueColumnHint: Defaults to the first column of the first row.
props.noKnowledgeBases: There are no knowledge bases available to this project.
props.acceptHint: Comma-separated extensions (.pdf, .docx…). Empty = whatever the knowledge base accepts.
props.label: Text
props.confirmHint: When set, this text is shown for confirmation before running.
props.columnsHint: Without columns, every column of the query is shown.
props.optionsHint: One per line: value=text (or just the value).
props.filtersHint: Each filter is an input: use it in the query as a “Filter” parameter with its name.
props.rowActionHint: Use $row.column in the workflow inputs or '{{row.column}}' in the message to the agent.

publish.unavailable: Publishing is not available in this environment
publish.noPermission: You need the builder role to publish
publish.title: Publication to production

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every change is a commit of the project. Compare a version with the current one and restore it.
versions.pick: Choose a version to compare it.
versions.diffLegend: Left: chosen version · Right: current draft
versions.restoreDescription: A new commit will bring back the interface as it was at {sha}. Unsaved changes will be lost.
versions.emptyDescription: Save the interface to create its first version.

share.title: Share
share.descriptionApp: The app uses production data and requires login unless you make it public.
share.descriptionChat: Share the chat page or embed it in your website with a single line.
share.notPublished: The URLs will work as soon as you publish the project to production.
share.embedHint: It can be shown inside an iframe on any website.
share.widgetHint: Paste this line at the end of your website's body: it adds a button that opens the chat.
